mapper.sql: ID, NAME, CODE, STATE, SCOPE, REMARK, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, DELETED, VERSION
mapper.select: SELECT R.ID, R.NAME, R.CODE, R.STATE, R.SCOPE, R.REMARK, R.CREATED_BY, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_BY, R.UPDATED_AT, R.DELETED FROM SPECTRA.SYS_ROLE R, SPECTRA.SYS_REL_USER_ROLE UR WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UR.ROLE_ID = R."ID" AND R.STATE = 1 AND R.DELETED IS NULL AND UR.DELETED IS NULL ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC;

SELECT R.ID FROM SPECTRA.SYS_ROLE R, SPECTRA.SYS_REL_USER_ROLE UR WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UR.ROLE_ID = R."ID" AND R.STATE = 1 AND R.DELETED IS NULL AND UR.DELETED IS NULL ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPECTRA.SYS_REL_USER_ROLE(ID, USER_ID, ROLE_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{uid}, #{rid}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT A.ID, A.PID, A.NAME, A.CODE, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATED_AT, A.UPDATED_BY, A.UPDATED_AT, A.DELETED, A.VERSION FROM SPECTRA.SYS_AUTHORITY A INNER JOIN SPECTRA.SYS_REL_ROLE_AUTHORITY RA ON RA.AUTHORITY_ID = A.ID AND RA.DELETED IS NULL WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{id} AND A.DELETED IS NULL ORDER BY A.ID

SELECT A.id, A.name, A.pid, A.icon, A.path, A.component, A.layout, A.sort, A.created_by, A.created_at, A.updated_by, A.updated_at, A.deleted, A.version FROM SPECTRA.SYS_MENU A INNER JOIN SPECTRA.SYS_REL_ROLE_MENU RM ON RM.MENU_ID = A.ID AND RM.DELETED IS NULL WHERE RM.ROLE_ID = #{id} AND A.DELETED IS NULL ORDER BY A.ID
